info.title: Actana Control Panel public API
info.description: Public REST API for Cores, Agents, Tasks and comments. Authenticate with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer ak_…`). Every call runs as the key's owner. A key restricted to chosen Cores gets 403 outside that scope; a key without the permission a route needs gets 403 too (every GET needs `read`, the Task writes `tasks:write`, the Agent writes `agents:write`); a revoked or expired key gets 401.

ApiKey.description: An API key created in Settings › API & integrations, with its permissions (read, tasks:write, agents:write) and Core scope. Shown once at create time. It may carry an expiry chosen at creation; after it the key gets 401.

autoRetry.description: Auto-retry (opt-in): { maxAttempts, retries, pendingAt (epoch ms of a pending retry or null), notice ({ id, kind: retry|gave-up|paused, text } or null) }; null when the Task did not opt in.

timeoutMinutes.description: The Task's time limit per attempt, in minutes (1-43200). null = No limit: the attempt runs until the agent reports or its Session ends.

sessionState.description: What the Session of the running attempt is doing; null when no attempt runs. working = busy; needs-input = waits for a person; interrupted = interrupted; idle-no-result = idle and no result file yet; exited = the Session ended. It never changes `status`: the result file is the only success signal. A change fires the webhook event `task.session_state_changed`.

sessionStateAt.description: When `sessionState` last changed (epoch ms); null with it.

watch.description: Only on an `assigned` or `in_progress` Task (so create with startNow, assign and comment & re-assign return it straight away, with no extra get), and only where a single Task is returned (create, status, update, comment & re-assign, stop, get), never on a list row. Wait by reading `url` (GET /api/watch/{token}, no API key) instead of polling the Task.

url.description: Absolute status URL: AC_PANEL_PUBLIC_URL when the Panel has it, else the origin of the request.

expiresAt.description: When the URL stops working (epoch ms); every read of the Task returns a fresh one.

get.description: The owner's Cores. A restricted key lists only the Cores in its scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, revoked or expired key

403.description: Key does not reach this Core, or lacks the read permission

404.description: No such Core of this owner

403.description: Key does not reach this Core, or lacks the read permission

get.description: The owner's Agents. A restricted key lists only Agents on Cores in its scope.

403.description: Key does not reach the Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

409.description: Conflict. When the Core's harness check refuses it, the body also carries `code`: `core_harnesses_unavailable` (the Core cannot be asked), `harness_not_ready` (the harness is still being checked: ask again) or `harness_missing_on_core` (not available there)

403.description: Key does not reach the Agent's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

patch.description: Change an Agent's `name`, `model` and/or `flags` in place; the id stays. A field that is left out is kept, `model: null` clears the model. The harness and the Core cannot be changed, and any other field is refused with 400. Needs `agents:write`.

400.description: Validation error, or a field that cannot be changed

403.description: Key does not reach the Agent's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

409.description: A default Agent cannot be changed, or another Agent on the Core has that name

403.description: Key does not reach the Agent's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

409.description: A default Agent cannot be deleted

get.description: One page of the Sessions on one Core, asked of the Core itself: running and waiting-for-input Sessions first, then newest activity. Lean rows: no prompt text and no transcript. `nextCursor` is the `cursor` for the next page and is null on the last; `total` counts every Session the filters match on that Core.

parameters.name: coreId
parameters.description: The Core whose Sessions to list.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Opaque.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: true lists archived Sessions instead of active ones.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only Sessions whose name contains this text.

live.description: True while the Core holds a live terminal for the Session.

400.description: `coreId` is missing, `limit` is not a whole number from 1 to 100, `status` or `archived` is not valid, or `cursor` was not issued by this API

403.description: The key does not reach the Core, or lacks the `read` permission

get.description: The owner's Tasks. A restricted key lists only Tasks on Cores in its scope. Without `limit`, every Task is returned with its full row, as before. With `limit`, one page is returned, newest update first, and the rows leave out `description` (read it with GET /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}); `nextCursor` is the `cursor` for the next page and is null on the last.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100. Omit to list every Task with its description.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Opaque. Needs `limit`.

parameters.name: sessionState
parameters.description: Only Tasks whose Session is in this state: one of working, needs-input, interrupted, idle-no-result, exited, or a comma list of them (for example `needs-input,idle-no-result`). Filtered in the database, so it works with `limit`.

200.description: Tasks. Each row carries `sessionState` and `sessionStateAt`, never `watch`. `nextCursor` is present only when `limit` was given.

tasks.description: Full rows without `limit`; with `limit`, rows without `description`.

nextCursor.description: Only with `limit`. Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null when there is none.

400.description: `limit` is not a whole number from 1 to 100, `cursor` was not issued by this API, `cursor` was given without `limit`, or `sessionState` is empty or names an unknown state

timeoutMinutes.description: Time limit per attempt, in minutes (1-43200). Omit for 60; null = No limit.

autoRetry.description: Opt in to auto-retry: when the Task's Session dies without a result, the Task is assigned again after 1, 5, then 15 minutes, up to maxAttempts attempts. null = off. A value above the Panel's ceiling is clamped and the answer carries `autoRetryClamped: { requested, ceiling }`.

fromTaskId.description: The id of your own Task, set it when your Session creates a Resume / hand-over Task.

403.description: Key does not reach the Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

get.summary: Get one Task with its comments

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

patch.summary: Change a Task's title, description, time limit or any of them
patch.description: Fires `task.updated`. `title` and `description` are allowed in draft, assigned, done, failed and partial; refused with 409 while the Task is `in_progress`, because its Session already has the prompt. `timeoutMinutes` is allowed at any status, including `in_progress` (the running attempt picks it up within a minute), and a change adds a system comment to the Task's thread. A request that carries `timeoutMinutes` together with `title` or `description` on an `in_progress` Task is refused as a whole.

timeoutMinutes.description: Time limit per attempt, in minutes (1-43200); null = No limit.

autoRetry.description: Opt in to auto-retry: when the Task's Session dies without a result, the Task is assigned again after 1, 5, then 15 minutes, up to maxAttempts attempts. null = off. A value above the Panel's ceiling is clamped and the answer carries `autoRetryClamped: { requested, ceiling }`.

400.description: No field given, an empty title, or a time limit that is not null or a whole number 1-43200

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

delete.summary: Delete a Task with its comments and history
delete.description: Fires `task.deleted`. Refused with 409 while the Task is `in_progress`. Files the Task left in the Shared folder stay.

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

post.summary: Move a Task to assigned or draft
post.description: Only the operator moves `assigned` and `draft` are accepted. Other statuses are the dispatcher's or the result watcher's.

autoRetry.description: Set or clear (null) the Task's auto-retry together with the move; see createTask.

400.description: Status not allowed for a key client

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

409.description: Illegal status move. A Task that is in_progress cannot be re-assigned or sent back to draft: stop it first with POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/stop.

post.description: Only a Task that is `in_progress` can be stopped. Its Session is stopped on the Core and the Task becomes `failed` with a system comment (`Stopped by <name>: <reason>`), after which it can be re-assigned to run in a new Session. The Task is failed even when the Core is offline; `session.outcome` then says `unreachable` and the Session may still be running. A result file arriving later is kept as a comment and does not change the Task.

reason.description: Why it is stopped; recorded in the system comment.

200.description: The failed Task and what happened to its Session (null when none was recorded)

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs
Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

post.summary: Add a comment, or Comment & re-assign
post.description: A comment is a note: nothing is typed into the Task's Session unless `deliver` is `now`. The comment's author is `<key name> (API key)` with authorKind `user`. With `deliver: now` on a running Task the comment is also typed into its Session; the 201 body then carries `delivery` ({ mode: now, delivered, reason? }). A Session that is waiting for input is never typed into: the comment stays a note and `reason` says why.

deliver.description: Also type the comment into the Task's running Session.

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

409.description: Re-assign refused. A Task that is in_progress must be stopped first with POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/stop.

post.summary: End a finished Task's harness and free its Core slot
post.description: The Session stays: its transcript is kept and a comment with `reassign` continues it.

200.description: The Task and what happened to its Session

403.description: Key does not reach the Task's Core, or lacks the permission the route needs

409.description: The Task is in_progress (stop it first), has no Session, or someone is working in the Session

get.summary: Read a Task attempt's status (no API key)
get.description: Unauthenticated: the signed token in the path is the whole credential, so no `Authorization` header is needed. Take the URL from `watch.url` of a Task. It answers status only (no title, description, comments or report text); read the report with GET /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}. While the Task is `assigned` (queued for a Core, or starting) it answers `status: "assigned"` with `sessionState` and `result` null and `pollAfterSeconds` 5; the same URL then follows the attempt that starts. Wait by calling it again after `pollAfterSeconds`; `0` means the Task is finished. The URL expires after the attempt's time limit plus 10 minutes (24 hours from the read of a Task with No time limit; for an `assigned` Task, that window plus the time limit, so it outlives a queue wait), and stops working when a later attempt replaces it or the Task is stopped, moved back to draft or deleted (410). It is rate limited per token and globally (429).

result.description: The finished Task's status; null while it runs.

pollAfterSeconds.description: 0 finished; 2 within 30 s of a state change; 15 while waiting on a person or a result; else 5.

404.description: Not a token this Panel issued

410.description: The link has expired or been replaced (a new attempt, a stop, a delete)
